system.description:
A creature that leaves an enemy's melee reach without Disengaging provokes one melee attack from that enemy. Being moved by someone else (a shove, a push, a throw) or teleporting never provokes one, unless the ability causing it says so.

Each creature can answer one trigger per round (an Attack of Opportunity or another feature that responds to a trigger), regained at the start of its turn. A feature that gives extra reactions says so, and those extras can only be used for that feature (the Swashbuckler's Second Flourish). Combat Reflexes also lets its holder attack a creature that moves past it.

Press Use to spend your reaction for the round, then attack with your weapon.

activities.name: Attack of Opportunity
activities.text: Your reaction: one melee attack against a creature leaving your melee reach without Disengaging.
